description: Regression for the battle fallback deck: initial_state constructs an intentionally EMPTY persistent deck (descriptor deck-present section; the CARDS menu can no longer empty a deck because of DECK_MIN_CARDS) which forces battle_init_from_deck_state onto the packed starter-deck fallback. The 12-card table mirrors the granted composition (4x SW3, 3x SH2, 3x SW4, 2x DA1); the first five entries keep the granted deal order so the opening hand must render SW3 SW3 SH2 SH2 SW4 -- a mis-packed table would show a shuffled order and garbage type-15 codes
name: fallback_deck_starter
